秦伟一行人走了，在院里看热闹的邻居也都回去睡觉了，但是在王野家却开始了三堂会审。

王野家的堂屋现在只有四个人，赵爷爷，秦婉和王铁柱坐在餐桌旁。王野则站在餐桌另一边。不是王野不想坐下，而是秦婉不让。

秦婉冷着脸说：“说说吧！怎么回事儿？”

王野笑呵呵的说：“娘，我就是和赵大哥切磋切磋，谁知道他那么不经打。”

秦婉一拍桌子说：“你当老娘是傻子吗？给我说实话！”

王野见糊弄不过去了，就收起了嬉皮笑脸的神色，郑重的说：“我确实是故意的，原因有两个，一个是那个赵兵一脸的不屑，我看他不爽，给他个教训；再一个我要看看舅舅的态度，决定以后到底是融入他那个圈子，还是维持现状。”

秦婉听见王野说那个赵兵一脸不屑，就不那么生气了。秦婉当时只顾着和秦伟说话了，没有注意身后的警卫员，然后转头看向王铁柱说：“你看见了吗？”

王铁柱点点头说：“看见了。”

得到丈夫的肯定，秦婉就更不生气了。看不起自己家人，要是还不给他个教训，就太窝囊了。没那个实力，忍了也就忍了，人都打了，说明有实力，这要是再生王野的气，就有点胳膊肘往外拐了。

这时赵爷爷才是抓住了王野说的重点，就问：“看你舅舅什么态度？”

王野见秦婉脸色缓和了，就赶紧坐了下来。秦婉见王野坐下也没说话，就斜了他一眼。

王野喝了口水说：“如果我舅舅当场就跟我发火，我以后就维持现状，他当他的大领导，我上我的班。”

赵爷爷听到这话，欣然含笑的说：“你舅舅可是中将，你知道中将多大吗，你就舍得？”

王野一脸不屑的说：“赵爷爷，我又不傻，我能不知道中将多大？我也知道，有一个中将的舅舅对我的未来有莫大的帮助。但是我也知道，这世界没有免费的午餐。得到的越多，付出的就越多。而且现在的有些大院子弟，未来不一定都有好下场。”

赵爷爷继续问：“什么意思？”

王野继续说：“现在有太多的大院子弟仗着父辈的权威作威作福，我要融进这个圈子，迟早会跟他们起冲突。”

王野笑呵呵的说：“如果我得罪了舅舅战友家的孩子，我舅舅是站在我这个刚认得外甥这边，还是他战友那边呢？”

这一问吓得父母一头冷汗，是啊！真要到了那天，王家必须把委屈咽下去。

王野继续说：“得到了多大的便利，就得承受多大的风险。我得知道我能抗住多大的风险，才能决定要不要便利。现在太多的东西不是武力可以抗衡的，那个圈子太危险了。”

其实王野还有一个原因没说：过不了几年就起风了，这些高级将领很多都被波及。王野也想试试，这个舅舅值不值得他趟这趟浑水。

话分两头，在秦伟家里的书房也发生了同样的事情。秦伟和陈近岳坐在沙发上，赵兵和王虎站在不远处。

全屋的气氛压抑到了极点，就连秦伟的妻子孩子都在屋里不敢靠近书房。全都在客厅等着，一句话也不说。

就连两个小孩子也依偎在母亲身边不哭也不闹。因为他们的父亲一进门就脸色阴沉的进了书房，连招呼都没打。

秦伟先说话了：“王虎，说说，怎么回事儿。”

王虎一个立正说：“报告首长，我和赵兵正在院里等着，王野就过来给了我们一人一支烟，然后说我们警惕性很好，身手也不错吧！”

“赵兵说还行，听洛兮说你很厉害。王野说，听赵兵的口气就问是不是不信，赵兵说市井中有什么高手，王野让赵兵指点指点，接下来王野就带我们去了那个房间。”

“王野和赵兵的对战中，王野从第一招就占了绝对的上风。接着来就是王野对赵兵的单方面攻击，我见情况不对上前阻止，王野一脚就把我逼退，还说我敢插手连我一起打。然后首长们就进来了。”

秦伟和陈近岳交换了一个眼神，在王虎的回答中没有得到答案。

Qin Wei and his entourage left, and the neighbors who were watching the excitement in the courtyard also went back to sleep, but at Wang Ye's house, three sessions of interrogation began.

There are only four people in the main room of Wang Ye's family. Grandpa Zhao, Qin Wan and Wang Tiezhu are sitting at the dining table.Wang Ye stood on the other side of the dining table.It's not that Wang Ye doesn't want to sit down, but Qin Wan doesn't want to.

Qin Wan said with a cold face: "Tell me about it! What's going on?"

Wang Ye said with a smile: "Mom, I'm just competing with Brother Zhao. Who knew he was so inexperienced?"

Qin Wan slapped the table and said, "Do you think I'm a fool? Tell me the truth!"

Seeing that he couldn't be fooled, Wang Ye put away his playful smile and said solemnly: "I did do it on purpose. There are two reasons. One is that Zhao Bing looked disdainful. I saw that he was unhappy and taught him a lesson. The other one is that I want to see my uncle's attitude and decide whether to integrate into his circle in the future or maintain the status quo."

Qin Wan became less angry when she heard Wang Ye say that Zhao Bing looked disdainful.Qin Wan was only talking to Qin Wei at that time and did not pay attention to the guard behind her. Then she turned to Wang Tiezhu and said, "Did you see it?"

Wang Tiezhu nodded and said, "I saw it."

After receiving her husband's approval, Qin Wan became even less angry.He looks down on his own family and would be a coward if he didn't teach him a lesson.If you don't have that strength, you can just endure it if you endure it. People are beaten, which shows that you have strength. If you are angry with Wang Ye again, your elbows will be turned outward.

At this time, Grandpa Zhao caught the point of what Wang Ye said and asked, "What do you think of your uncle's attitude?"

Seeing Qin Wan's expression softening, Wang Ye quickly sat down.When Qin Wan saw Wang Ye sitting down without saying anything, she glanced at him sideways.

Wang Ye took a sip of water and said: "If my uncle gets angry with me on the spot, I will maintain the status quo from now on. He will be his big leader and I will work in my class."

When Grandpa Zhao heard this, he said happily with a smile: "Your uncle is a lieutenant general. Do you know how old the lieutenant general is, and you are willing to do it?"

Wang Ye said with disdain: "Grandpa Zhao, I'm not stupid. How can I not know how old the lieutenant general is? I also know that having an uncle who is a lieutenant general will be of great help to my future. But I also know that there is no free lunch in this world. The more you get, the more you pay. And some of the big boys now may not have a good ending in the future."

Grandpa Zhao continued to ask: "What do you mean?"

Wang Ye continued: "Nowadays, there are too many big brothers who rely on the authority of their fathers to dominate. If I want to integrate into this circle, sooner or later I will conflict with them."

Wang Ye said with a smile: "If I offend the children of my uncle's comrade-in-arms, will my uncle side with me, my newly recognized nephew, or with his comrades-in-arms?"

This question scared my parents into a cold sweat, yes!When that day comes, the Wang family must swallow their grievances.

Wang Ye continued: "The greater the convenience you get, the greater the risk you have to bear. I have to know how much risk I can withstand before I can decide whether to provide convenience. There are too many things now that cannot be countered by force, and that circle is too dangerous."

In fact, there is another reason Wang Ye didn't mention: in a few years, a storm will arise, and many of these senior generals will be affected.Wang Ye also wanted to try to see if this uncle was worth the trouble.

The words were divided into two parts, and the same thing happened in the study room of Qin Wei's home.Qin Wei and Chen Jinyue were sitting on the sofa, while Zhao Bing and Wang Hu were standing not far away.

The atmosphere in the whole house was extremely depressing. Even Qin Wei's wife and children were in the house and did not dare to approach the study.They all waited in the living room without saying a word.

Even the two little children cuddled up to their mother and neither cried nor fussed.Because their father entered the study with a gloomy face as soon as he entered the door, without even saying hello.

Qin Wei spoke first: "Wang Hu, tell me what's going on."

Wang Hu stood at attention and said: "Report to the leader, Zhao Bing and I are waiting in the courtyard. Wang Ye came over and gave each of us a cigarette, and then said that we are very vigilant and have good skills!"

"Zhao Bing said it was okay, and Luo Xi said you were very powerful. Wang Ye said, and after hearing Zhao Bing's tone, he asked if he didn't believe it. Zhao Bing said there were some masters in the market, and Wang Ye asked Zhao Bing to point out. Then Wang Ye took us to that room."

"In the battle between Wang Ye and Zhao Bing, Wang Ye had the absolute upper hand from the first move. Then came Wang Ye's unilateral attack on Zhao Bing. When I saw that the situation was not right, I stepped forward to stop him. Wang Ye kicked me back and said that I dared to intervene and fight with me. Then the leaders came in."

Qin Wei and Chen Jinyue exchanged glances, but did not get an answer from Wang Hu's answer.
